assumptions: The constraints and objectives given state the real requirements; DnaChisel's solver resolves them.
limits: A constraint the solver cannot satisfy is reported as unresolved, not silently dropped.
The search is heuristic: a better sequence may exist.
bio.jane/contract.question: What sequence satisfies these constraints and scores best on these objectives?

description: Run the DnaChisel optimizer over the subject with real constraints/objectives (GC window, pattern avoidance, translation enforcement, …). Emits the optimized sequence as a NEW record for downstream nodes.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

candidates.description: how many alternative solutions to produce (1 = a single solve). Candidate 1 is the plain unseeded answer; the rest run at seed+1, seed+2, …, so a listed alternative can be asked for again. Max 12.

constraints.description: DnaChisel constraint specs, e.g. [{"kind":"EnforceGCContent","mini":0.4,"maxi":0.6,"window":50}] — hard requirements the solution must satisfy. Valid `kind` values: EnforceTranslation, AvoidPattern, EnforceGCContent, AvoidHairpins, AvoidRareCodons, UniquifyAllKmers, CodonOptimize, EnforceSequence, AvoidChanges, EnforceChoice, EnforcePatternOccurence, AvoidStopCodons, EnforceMeltingTemperature, EnforceChanges, EnforceTerminalGCContent, SequenceLengthBounds, EnforceRbsStrength, AvoidHeterodimerization, AllowPrimer, EnforceRegionsCompatibility, AvoidMatches, AvoidBlastMatches.

objectives.description: DnaChisel objective specs — soft goals the solver maximises. Same `kind` values as constraints: EnforceTranslation, AvoidPattern, EnforceGCContent, AvoidHairpins, AvoidRareCodons, UniquifyAllKmers, CodonOptimize, EnforceSequence, AvoidChanges, EnforceChoice, EnforcePatternOccurence, AvoidStopCodons, EnforceMeltingTemperature, EnforceChanges, EnforceTerminalGCContent, SequenceLengthBounds, EnforceRbsStrength, AvoidHeterodimerization, AllowPrimer, EnforceRegionsCompatibility, AvoidMatches, AvoidBlastMatches.

randomization_threshold.description: DnaChisel `randomization_threshold` (default 10000). LOWER it to force the stochastic search: an objective-driven problem is deterministic, so without this every candidate comes back identical. Advanced.

seed.description: base seed for the alternatives — the same seed returns the same set. Advanced.

name: optimize_sequence

caiAfter.description: CAI after optimization, or null when not computable (no codon table to score against): a 0 would read as the worst possible adaptation

candidates.description: every alternative solution: its seed, sequence, edit count, GC and CAI — compare them before choosing. Empty unless `candidates` asks for more than one

distinct.description: how many of the candidates are DIFFERENT sequences — 1 means the problem has a single answer, not that the run failed. The engine omits it for a single-candidate run, where it is 1 by definition

gcProfile.description: windowed GC before and after, at each window's centre: the stretches the solver moved, which the two whole-sequence GC numbers average away

record.description: the optimized sequence as a record
